passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Octopuses have three hearts.
• Their blood is blue.
• The color comes from a molecule called hemocyanin.
• Hemocyanin contains copper and carries oxygen through the body.
stem: The student wants to explain why octopus blood is blue. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
choices: Octopus blood is blue because it contains hemocyanin, a copper-containing molecule that carries oxygen.
Octopuses have three hearts, which pump blue blood through their bodies and to their gills.
An octopus has blue blood and three hearts, two unusual features among animals.
Hemocyanin, a molecule that carries oxygen, is found in the blood of octopuses.
steps: The goal asks why the blood is blue.
The notes say the color comes from hemocyanin, which contains copper.
Only one choice connects the color to hemocyanin with "because."
The others mention the blue color or hemocyanin, but never link them.
key: An explanation must connect the cause to the effect.
